passages.text:
An order can be cancelled only while its status is "preparing" — before it
has been handed to a carrier. Once an order shows "shipped", it can no
longer be cancelled; the customer should refuse delivery or return it after
it arrives.

cancel for a full refund. Staying quiet and hoping the parcel turns up is

A cancelled order is refunded in full to the original payment method within
3-5 business days. Pre-orders are never charged until shipment, so a
cancelled pre-order shows no refund because no charge was made.

args.question: Can Amazon issue a refund when the customer has already disputed the charge with their bank?

passages.policy: Refunds and chargebacks — A dispute belongs to the bank
passages.text:
A customer may dispute a charge with their card issuer instead of asking
us. Once a dispute is open the case belongs to the issuer, and support
does not also refund it — that pays the customer twice and the account
goes negative. Any mention of a chargeback, a dispute, or "I called my
bank" is escalated, not refunded here.

passages.policy: Refunds and chargebacks — What we may never say
passages.text:
Never tell a customer they cannot dispute a charge, or that disputing one
will affect their account. Both are untrue, and saying either is itself a
violation.

A refund goes back to the original payment method. Card refunds are sent
within 3-5 business days; when it appears is controlled by the customer's
bank, so that part is never promised as a date.

args.question: Does the balance on an Amazon gift card expire?

passages.text:
A simplified summary for support training. Not legal advice — compliance
questions go to a human agent.

Under the US Credit CARD Act of 2009, gift card funds may not expire for
at least five years from the date the money was loaded, and dormancy fees
are tightly limited.

passages.policy: Gift cards — What that means here
passages.text:
- A gift card purchase is not refundable, and the balance on it does not
  expire. Never tell a customer their balance has lapsed — balances are
  looked up, not assumed.
- A balance is not converted to cash, except where a state law requires it
  below a small threshold. That is a human agent's decision, not ours.
- A gift card bought with a stolen card may be frozen. That is a fraud
  matter and is escalated, not explained.

A refund goes back to the original payment method. Card refunds are sent
within 3-5 business days; when it appears is controlled by the customer's
bank, so that part is never promised as a date.

passages.policy: Customer data — Access and deletion requests
passages.text:
Under the GDPR in the EU and UK, and the CCPA in California, a customer
may ask for a copy of their data or for it to be deleted. Support cannot
action either one: both need verified identity and both have a legal
deadline. They go to a human agent, and the customer is told that within
the conversation.

passages.policy: Customer data — Assume it is read back
passages.text:
Every chat is retained and reviewable. Nothing is written about a customer
that could not be shown to that customer.

passages.policy: Customer data — What never enters a chat
passages.text:
Full card numbers, security codes, passwords, one-time passcodes. If a
customer sends one, it is removed from the record and they are told not to
send it again. Under the card industry's PCI DSS rules, a card number
sitting in a transcript is a reportable incident, not a small mistake.
